To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood — demo & quick tech check

Hi Hannah,

I just self-signed up for a trial yesterday (Alison Nguyen, ClearWave) and poked around the hosted API briefly. We’re evaluating inference platforms for a small POC — our stack is Node + internal K8s and we care a lot about latency and audit logs.

I'd love a quick 20–30 minute walkthrough focused on:
- how Redwood handles private deployments (VPC options)
- cost/throughput trade-offs for 1–2 M tokens/month
- what developer onboarding looks like (SDK, examples)

I saw the auto-responder but wanted to check availability this week. I’m PT (Seattle). Best windows: Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Thanks — I can share a calendar invite if that’s easiest.

— Alison
Alison Nguyen
Senior Engineer, ClearWave Inc.

Hi Alison —

Thanks for signing up and for the note. Welcome! I’m sharing two quick options so we can get you a focused session:

• 20-min developer-focused walkthrough (recommended) — covers SDK, quick integration, and cost knobs
• 30-min technical session — adds architecture and private deployment details

Pick a slot here and it will create a calendar event: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/ben-20min

If you’ve already got a preferred slot/time, reply and we’ll match it. I’ve cc’d Ben from our SDR team — he can help with scheduling and an ICS if you need it.

Quick deeplink to the environment you created (so Ben/engineer can pre-check): https://trial.redwood.ai/deeplink/session/clearwave

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Growth, Redwood Inference
